answer: The vine I would price into every new account is Bluetooth device graph of paired wearables: a watch and earbuds paired for months, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a watch and earbuds paired for months is bound to a single identity — the signal is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the mesa for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
